runs.text: thirty one Israels fit inside Texas. Here's Israel at true size: twenty two thousand and seventy two square kilometres. West Bank and Gaza shaded, not counted. Now, fly it to America. New Jersey first. Almost a perfect match. Lake Michigan swallows it more than two and a half times. California: nineteen Israels, side by side. Texas: one, two, three... thirty one and a half. And the whole United States? four hundred and forty five. Coast to coast, plus Alaska. Every copy is true size, even up in Alaska. Size isn't everything. It's just where the conversation starts. Which US state should I drop Israel on next? Count Texas again.
